bns:Component.name: Send_RetryHistory_Insert_V2
bns:Component.bns:description: Database V2 Dynamic Insert into EDV_INTEGRATION.RETRY_HISTORY (SQL Server) - Sub_Retrigger_Handler records a manual retry attempt. All 4 columns are parameterized via "? AS name" (Dynamic Insert requires every target column to be parameter-bound - a literal SQL expression or correlated subquery mixed in comes back NULL, same bug class fixed earlier for TRANSACTION_ID/NEWID()). RETRY_NUMBER is computed beforehand by Get_RetryHistory_NextNumber_V2 and passed in as a value; RETRY_TYPE/RESULT are static values (MANUAL/REQUESTED) bound as parameters instead of SQL literals. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57

field.value: INSERT INTO EDV_INTEGRATION.RETRY_HISTORY (TRANSACTION_ID, RETRY_NUMBER, RETRY_TYPE, RESULT) SELECT transaction_id, retry_number, retry_type, result FROM (SELECT ? AS transaction_id, ? AS retry_number, ? AS retry_type, ? AS result) AS S
